profile.headline: Software Engineer - HDHT
profile.summary:
As a Creative Technologist specializing in Data Science, visualization, and user interaction, I thrive on building inventive and analytical solutions. My career journey encompasses a role as a data wrangling lead, where I play a pivotal role in providing expert consultation on technical issues. 

I've transformed critical manual data reporting into automated pipelines, ensuring seamless workflows and optimal efficiency. My experience includes creating 25+ dashboards displaying a variety of visualizations, KPIs, performance metrics, and financial impacts, making vast amounts of data accessible to business partners and marketing teams. 

I can handle diverse challenges with a background in programming, machine learning, cloud-based systems, automation, data manipulation, information analytics, and user experience and design. My ability to connect API and data servers to automated reporting processes has reduced workloads and demonstrated a commitment to continuous improvement. I am a hardworking, enthusiastic, and optimistic individual who values performance and growth, contribution, and efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created 25+ dashboards displaying various KPIs, making vast data accessible to business partners and marketing teams.
• Implemented end-to-end automation of data reporting and visualizations from remote cloud-based virtual machines.
• Developed manual reporting for marketing campaigns, external teams, and business requests, improving data reporting turnaround.
• Accountable for analyzing, organizing, and manipulating vast datasets and servers ranging over a billion records.
• Established processes for reporting key organizational performance analytics on vehicle modem connectivity, feature activation, and customer exposure to system failures.
• Enjoy continuous learning opportunities as the subscription platform grows.
positions.insights: Skills: Tekton CI/CD · HashiCorp · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Kubernetes · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Cloud Computing · Microsoft Power BI · Google Cloud Run · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Co-Founder + CTO
positions.description:
• Generated over $70k in total revenue, with a 600% increase in annual revenue from 2019.
• Directed the completion of 55+ projects, including client communication and project management.
• Modernised the logistics systems to produce records, report performance, and form business insights.
• Counselled with company heads and CEOs on digital development strategies for their companies.

Studio_1201 is a multi-disciplinary design consultancy the provides creative and technical services and solutions. Our clientele consists of small businesses across the US and internationally.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience Design (UED) · jQuery · User Research · Python (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · Adobe Creative Suite · Data Science · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · web3.js · Microsoft Excel · Front-end Development · Web Development · User Experience (UX) · Agile Methodologies · Autodesk Fusion 360 · Data Analysis · HTML · Programming · Adobe Illustrator · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Vector Illustration · Graphic Design · Adobe Photoshop · 3D Modeling

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.locationName: Allen Park, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Successfully transformed critical platform-wide manual data reporting into automated processes, dashboards, and visualizations, which improved the overall efficiency of the data reporting system.
• Established data hierarchies on unexplored datasets, enabling the organization to leverage untapped datasets ranging from a couple of million to over a billion records.
• Connected API and data servers to automated weekly and monthly reporting processes, significantly reducing the reporting team's workload.
•Demonstrated and consulted on programming logic, project testing, and verification, improving the quality of the overall data reporting system.
•Thrived in autonomous work, leading the definition, design, execution, and implementation of projects derived from ongoing initiatives and areas of improvement.

As a contracted Data Engineer at Brooksource, I worked on the Foundational Services team, contributing to the Ford Subscription Services platform. I leverage my skills in SQL, data analytics, and visualization tools to support digital service offerings, collaborate with diverse groups, and make impactful contributions to scalable applications, all within an agile environment.

positions.title: Assistant Project Manager
positions.description:
• Led regular team meetings, reporting progress in platform meetings to stakeholders. 
• Oversaw team obligations, ad hoc requests, and completed task reviews. Successfully onboarded new team members and a new project manager into their roles and responsibilities.
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities by assuming project manager responsibilities after my manager's resignation. 

My engineering managers and project owner decided that over the last few months, I'd been showcasing strong work ethic and communication skills, and they offered me the opportunity to fill this position temporarily until HR hired a replacement. This leadership experience resulted in a short but informative venture teaching the differences between organization, execution, and presentation.

positions.title: Customer and Product Analyst
positions.description:
• Assessed the utility of the untapped raw business data and generated actionable insights for Millers.
• Consolidated, Analized, and manipulated 98k over 2 million data points using python pandas, SQL and R.
• Adapted machine learning to cluster buyers via behavior and delivered data-driven insights for conversion.
• Interpreted the location data using Power BI to conceive heatmaps for conversion rates across the US.

One academic year long Information analysis thesis project in partnership with Miller's Professional Imaging under the oversight of the University of Michigan School of Information.
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · User Research · Python (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · Data Science · C (Programming Language) · Microsoft Excel · R (Programming Language) · Data Analysis · Programming · Machine Learning · Django · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Big Data · MySQL

positions.title: Research Project Manager
positions.description:
• Pioneered an education video series about algorithms, along with a Professor, led a team of eight students.
• Conceived the foundation for interdisciplinary team workflow between the research and creative teams.
• Guided the production of six animated videos that visually communicate complex data science topics.
• Advised the future team on content marketing strategies through analysis of current content performance.

Algorithms and Society, an organization dedicated to educating the community about the risks and dangers of information technology, such as websites, platforms, and search engines. My responsibilities included.

positions.description:

• Built and trained a Machine learning model to predict the performance of content posted to the platform.
Semester long Information analysis project in partnership with the Library of Congress under the oversight of the University of Michigan School of Information.

positions.title: Server Trainer
positions.description:
As a Server Trainer at Good Time Charley's, one of Ann Arbors top college bars, I excelled in a face-paced work environment. I regularly took on additional responsibility around the restaurant leading to promotion during my time serving. My responsibilities included:
- Floor preparation and restaurant closing
- Providing excellent service to customers
- Waiting, Hosting, Training, and Food running

positions.title: Animator
positions.description:
As an Animator for Energy Design Engineers, I curated website content into animated and interactive graphics. In addition, I worked closely with the CEO to interpret the essence of this fantastic sustainability company into a visual experience to help users understand the companies purpose and impact. My responsibilities included:
- Design and animation of vector graphics.
- DOM, HTML and CSS development.
- Customer analysis and research

positions.title: Draftsman/Text book Illustrator
positions.description:
As a Textbook Illustrator, I worked closely with a professor from the University to create figures for an EECS graduate course. During this experience, I curated guided wave optics, nonlinear optics, lasers, and quantum optics principles into professional textbook figures. My Responsibilities included:
- Creation of vector graphics visually representing formulas.
- Organizing and exporting files to be uploaded into the textbook.
- Formatting files for textbook specifications.
